references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.118 (as amended by Act No. 7 B.E. 2562); Ministerial Regulation No. 394 B.E. 2567
references.quote: Severance at 30 days of final wage after 120 days of service, rising to 90, 180, 240, 300 and 400 days at 1, 3, 6, 10 and 20 years; not owed under s.118 para 3 or s.119. Tax exemption up to 400 wage days and 600,000 baht.

description: Severance on termination: 30, 90, 180, 240, 300 or 400 days of final wage at the day rate, by service (120 days, 1, 3, 6, 10, 20 years); none under s.118 para 3 or s.119 (LPA s.118).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.17, 17/1
references.quote: Notice of termination is given on or before a pay date to take effect on the next and need not exceed three months; short notice is paid as wages for the shortfall.

conversion:
if (ctx.entry.unit === 'MONEY') return ctx.entry.quantity;
return ctx.day_rate * ctx.entry.quantity;
description: Wages for notice not given: the amount entered, or the days entered × the day rate (LPA s.17/1).

references.title: Wage Committee Notification on Minimum Wage Rates (No. 14) B.E. 2568; Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.79(3), 88, 90
references.quote: Minimum daily wage by province from 1 July 2025: 400 baht in Bangkok, Chachoengsao, Chonburi, Phuket, Rayong, Koh Samui, and nationwide for category 2-4 hotels and service establishments; 380 baht in Mueang Chiang Mai and Hat Yai; 372 to 337 baht elsewhere.

description: Shortfall below the minimum daily wage: (minimum for the worksite − day rate) × days entered (Wage Committee Notification No. 14).

references.title: Revenue Code ss.40(1), 50(1)
references.quote: A bonus is employment income withheld under s.50(1); it is not SSO or WCF wage.

description: Paid on top of ordinary wages: accumulates in ADDITIONAL_WAGES; SSO, PVD and WCF read ORDINARY_WAGES; PND1 withholds the tax this bonus adds in the month it is paid.

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.122
references.quote: An employee dismissed under s.121 after six consecutive years gets, beyond s.118, 15 days of final wage for each year of service, up to 360 days.

description: Extra severance for a technology dismissal after six years: 15 days of final wage per year of service (a part year over 180 days counts), up to 360 days (LPA s.122).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.121
references.quote: A dismissal for reorganisation through machinery or technology needs 60 days notice to the labour inspector and the employees; short notice owes 60 days of final wage in lieu.

eligibility:
const ended = get(ctx.subject.employment, 'effective_range.to', null);
return ended == null || ctx.entry.incurred_on <= ended;
description: 60 days of final wage at the day rate in lieu of the technology-dismissal notice (LPA s.121).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.120 para 3 (as replaced by Act No. 7 B.E. 2562)
references.quote: A relocation that substantially affects the employee or family and is refused owes special severance at the s.118 rate.

description: Special severance for refusing a relocation, at the s.118 severance scale (LPA s.120).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.120 paras 1-2, 4 (as replaced by Act No. 7 B.E. 2562)
references.quote: The employer posts the relocation notice at least 30 days before the move; short notice owes 30 days of final wage in lieu.

eligibility:
const ended = get(ctx.subject.employment, 'effective_range.to', null);
return ended == null || ctx.entry.incurred_on <= ended;
description: 30 days of final wage at the day rate in lieu of the relocation notice (LPA s.120).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.117
references.quote: When the investigation clears the employee, the employer pays the full working-day wage for the suspension period with 15 percent a year interest.

description: The withheld part of suspension pay, with interest, owed when the investigation clears the employee: the amount entered (LPA s.117).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.9
references.quote: Late security money, wages, overtime, holiday pay, severance or special severance carry interest at 15 percent a year; a wilful default adds 15 percent of the unpaid amount for every 7 days after the first 7.

conversion:
if (ctx.entry.unit === 'MONEY') return ctx.entry.quantity;
return (ctx.month_wage * ctx.lookup.annual_rate * ctx.entry.quantity) / ctx.lookup.days_per_year;
description: Interest on late wages at 15% a year: the amount entered, or the monthly wage × 15% × days late ÷ 365 (LPA s.9).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) ss.56, 62, 64
references.quote: A holiday under ss.28-30 not granted, or granted short, is paid at the s.62 and s.63 rates as if worked: 1× with holiday pay, 2× without it.

description: Pay for holiday hours not granted: hours × hour rate × 1 for a monthly wage, × 2 for a daily or hourly wage (LPA s.64).

references.title: Labour Protection Act B.E. 2541 (1998) s.10
references.quote: Security money may be taken only for work, in the amounts and by the keeping method the Minister's notification allows, and is returned with interest within 7 days of the exit.

description: Security deposit taken from pay, only for a post allowed to take one: the amount entered (LPA s.10).

references.title: A statutory correction is an adhoc entry on this item. A year that comes out overpaid raises an obligation for the HR controller to enter it.

description: Tax or a contribution overpaid, paid back to the employee. The entry quantity is the refund; the statutory schemes are not re-run.
